On The 6 th Of March, 2026

Appearance:
 Shri Deepak Kumar Rawal - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Romil Verma appearing on behalf of Advocate Gene  ORDER
1] They are heard.
Perused the case-diary.

2] This is the first application filed by the appl 482 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/Section 438 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 for grant of anticipatory bail as he is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.675/2021 registered at Police Station Neelganga, Distric Ujjain for the offence punishable under Sections 423,
420, 120-B/34 of the IPC.

3] Allegation against the applicant is developing illegal colony alleging that applicant had sold 17 plots to different persons whose houses have been demolished by the Municipal Corporation on the ground that the construction was carried out on govt. land and accordingly, an FIR was lodged against the present applicant.

4] Counsel for the applicant has submitted that he has been falsely NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-IND:6065 2 MCRC-6286-2026 implicated in the case.
It is further submitted that there are no criminal antecedents against the present applicant.

He also submits that in the proceedings of civil suit which has been filed by the present applicant alongwith the plot holders there is a temporary injunction granted by the Court on 11.02.2021 directing the Municipal Deepak Nokwal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8145838/
1 Corporation not to carry out any further demolition activity.

sentences.text: It is submitted that although, the present case was also lodged in the year 2021 but due to Covid-19 no action was taken recently, the applicant was implicated in the case.
The applicant is ready to cooperate in the investigation.

Thus,
it is prayed that the anticipatory bail application should be allowed.
5] Counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the prayer.

6] Having considered the rival submissions and on perusal of the case diary and also considering the order passed by the Civil Court wherein the applicant has filed a civil suit alongwith 16 plot holders, in such circumstances the custodial interrogation of the applicant does not appear to be necessary, this Court is inclined to allow the present application for grant of anticipatory bail.
7] Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail, upon his executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (rupees twenty five thousand only) and furnishing one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer (Investigating Officer).
The applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a Police Officer, as and when required.
He shall further NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:6065 3 MCRC-6286-2026 abide by the other conditions enumerated in Sub Section (2) of Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
8] Accordingly, MCRC stands allowed.
Certified copy as per rules.
